song_story.overview: 1, 2, 3, 4 is a cold, deliberately unsentimental song about a one-night arrangement with clear rules and no illusions. LEE HI counts down the hours of a hookup like a countdown clock, laying out from the start that this isn't going to turn into anything — no contact after, no lingering feelings, no pretending it was love. The counting motif runs through the whole song, ticking down both literal hours and the numbered rules of the arrangement.
song_story.cultural_root: The song is a deliberate rejection of the more common Korean pop narrative of romantic devotion and lingering heartbreak found throughout most of this playlist — instead of longing for connection, the singer sets firm boundaries and treats emotional attachment as something to actively avoid. 눈치 챙겨 (read the room / catch a clue) is blunt, modern slang, used here almost as an insult, telling the other person not to mistake a physical encounter for something romantic.

verse_1.lines: 잔을 채워 하나 둘 셋 pour up / 넌 내게 말하듯 눈을 맞춰 hold up / 옷엔 낯선 향이 배어서 / 이젠 내 향이 다 빠졌어 / 이 자리에서 딴생각은 skip / 난 너와 하는 스킨십이 / 익숙한 듯 네 몸과 자연스레 섞이지 / 한 꺼풀씩 벗겨진 너와 내 맘 / 긴 밤이 지나면 / 뒤돌고 떠나 / 연락 따윈 nah
verse_1.literal: Fill the glass, one two three, pour up / you look at me like you're about to say something, hold up / your clothes carry an unfamiliar scent / by now my own scent has completely faded from them / skip any other thoughts in this moment / being physical with you feels / strangely natural, like it's second nature / layer by layer, your guard and mine come undone
verse_1.context: 낯선 향이 배어서 / 이젠 내 향이 다 빠졌어 — 'an unfamiliar scent has soaked in / now my scent has completely faded' — uses scent as physical proof that this isn't the first time or the only person for either of them, setting a matter-of-fact, unromantic tone from the start.

chorus.lines: 하나둘 세면 다 / 없어질 이 사이 / 난 이미 모든 대답을 했어 다 / 하나 둘 셋 us two / 하나둘씩 사라지는 중 / 어제 일은 지웠어 쭉 / 하나 둘 셋 넷 You, you, you, you / 하나 둘 셋 us two / 하나둘씩 희미해져 쭉 / 하나 둘 셋 넷 / 그때 가서 울고불고 자꾸 눈물 짤 거면
chorus.literal: One two three, us two / one by one, disappearing / I erased what happened yesterday, completely / one two three four, you you you you / one two three, us two / one by one, fading away / I don't want to think about you
chorus.context: 하나둘씩 사라지는 중 — 'disappearing one by one' — the counting isn't just a hook, it structures the whole song's logic: everything about this encounter, including the person, is something being counted down and erased rather than kept.

verse_2.lines: 이제 그만 꺼져줘 Please 기회 줄 테니까 / 하나 둘 셋 넷 다섯 시간 지나면 난 / 사라질 테니까 이제 그만 잊어줘 / 사랑이라 포장 말고 / 눈치 챙겨 버려줘 / 귀 아파 Darling please shut your mouth / 다 챙겼음 숫자 셀게 Ay / 하나 둘 셋 us two / 하나둘씩 사라지는 중 / 어제 일은 지웠어 쭉 / 하나 둘 셋 넷 You, you, you, you
verse_2.literal: Rule No. 1: what happens in Vegas stays in Vegas / Rule No. 2: whatever I say, you go along with / I already told you, you're not my number one / if you're going to end up crying and making a scene later / just get lost now, please, I'm giving you the chance / one two three four five hours pass and then / I'll be gone, so just forget me already
verse_2.context: 그때 가서 울고불고 — 'crying and making a fuss later' — 울고불고 is a set expression for dramatic, uncontrolled crying, used dismissively here as a warning against getting attached, framed almost as a rule being broken in advance.

final_line.lines: 하나 둘 셋 us two / 하나둘씩 희미해져 쭉 / 하나 둘 셋 넷 / Oh 1, 2, 3 시간이 다 / 지나면 우리는 몰라 / 이 기울어진 밤 지나 / 내 손목엔 6 o’clock yeah / 하나 둘 셋 us two / 하나둘씩 사라지는 중 / 어제 일은 지웠어 쭉 / 하나 둘 셋 넷 You, you, you, you / 하나 둘 셋 us two / 하나둘씩 희미해져 쭉 / 하나 둘 셋 넷
final_line.literal: 1, 2, 3 o'clock, once the time passes / we won't know each other anymore / past this tilted night / it's 6 o'clock on my wrist / I'm so f*ing good at goodbye / we don't know each other, right? / even if we turn back around
final_line.context: 기울어진 밤 (a tilted night) is a poetic way to say the night is late, past its peak, about to end — paired with the literal clock time on her wrist, grounding the song's whole countdown structure in an actual timestamp rather than a vague sense of time passing.

artist_context: LEE HI is known for a deep, distinctive vocal tone and a catalog that ranges between vulnerable ballads and blunt, self-assured tracks like this one, which leans into a confident, boundary-setting persona rather than her more typically emotional material.
honorific_level: informal — blunt 반말 mixed with English throughout, deliberately cold and direct

grammar_highlights.usage: 'In the middle of doing X,' marks an ongoing process. Appears in 사라지는 중 — 'in the process of disappearing,' the countdown treated as already underway.
Gives a reason based on a completed action. Appears in 이제 그만 꺼져줘 Please 기회 줄 테니까 — combining reasoning with a blunt command.
Casual request/command form. Appears in 잊어줘 — 'forget me' — a direct, unsoftened instruction rather than a plea.
